mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, country_code, rating, content, created_at, updated_at FROM review WHERE country_code = #{countryCode} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (member_id, country_code, rating, content) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{countryCode}, #{rating}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET country_code = #{countryCode}, rating = #{rating}, content = #{content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
